title: Route all test stand-in writes through one child-process helper
summary: Fixes the root cause behind jobs 20261106-065752-jexx and 20261106-095820-edjm: in-process writes of executable stand-ins (ETXTBSY race) were patched site by site. Retry both: add a test-only athena-testkit crate whose write_executable writes via an sh child, convert every test site (including the xtask gitleaks fake and slot_exec.rs), and add a sound scan test that fails on any in-process executable write, including via wrappers.

defaults_applied.how: Helper, scan and stress tests are Rust.
Use syn for the scan rather than hand-parsing.
New crate has passing tests; fmt, clippy, test pass.
Fix at the single helper plus a mechanical scan covering all sites and wrappers.
Criteria run the scan and stress tests.
Docs, changelog and decision entry written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: eliminate the class 'test writes an executable stand-in in-process then execs it' (ETXTBSY under concurrent fork); audience is the maintainer and the verifier reading the diff and test output.

Code Survey: Code survey: grep over crates/ and xtask shows set_permissions/from_mode in tests at crates/athena-cli/tests/slot_exec.rs:54 and xtask/src/main.rs:809 (helper set_executable), plus production uses in crates/athena-core/src/{toolconfig,pin,snapshot}.rs, crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs and crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs:129 (test module). crates/athena-testkit does not yet exist. No records or data files are added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are not affected. The property is measured directly by a scan test over real source files plus a stress test, not via a stand-in.

Job 20261106-065752-jexx findings addressed: xtask gitleaks fake converted to the helper; CHANGELOG states only what the diff does; docs/architecture.md crate-table row is kept and now listed; stress test asserts/prints the in-process ETXTBSY count visibly (not only with --nocapture), e.g. written into the assertion message or a non-captured output.

Job 20261106-095820-edjm finding addressed: the scan resolves wrappers, collecting workspace functions whose bodies call set_permissions/from_mode/set_mode (xtask set_executable, pin::set_writable, toolconfig::set_executable, snapshot::set_mode) and flags test-code calls to them, and flags Command::new("chmod") in test code; a planted-violation unit test covers set_executable(&fake). The nit about unchanged test_support.rs and git lib.rs is dropped: they are listed with low probability.

Files changed by both earlier candidates are kept as deliverables (same set as job 20261106-095820-edjm). Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock edits are workspace member and dev-dependency additions only (syn for the scan, per buy-first).
Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/test_support.rs, crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs, xtask/src/main.rs are extended, not replaced.

acceptance_criteria.text: The change description/CHANGELOG names the root cause (executable stand-ins written in-process with no single helper and no mechanical enumeration of write sites) and the fix at the origin: one helper athena_testkit::write_executable that writes via an sh child (cat > tmp && chmod 755 tmp && mv tmp final).

Grep of test code (xtask/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/*.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs, crates/athena-core/src/{checks,reading}.rs, crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs) finds no in-process executable write: no std::fs::write followed by set_permissions/set_executable; the xtask gitleaks fake and crates/athena-cli/tests/slot_exec.rs use the helper.

Run `cargo test -p athena-testkit`: the scan test passes on the tree and fails on planted violations, including a wrapper call set_executable(&fake), set_permissions with 0o755, from_mode, and Command::new("chmod") in test code; the planted-violation unit tests demonstrate it fails without the change's detection logic.

Run `cargo test -p athena-testkit --test stand_in_stress`: the helper variant records 0 ETXTBSY over many write-then-exec cycles with concurrent forking threads, and the in-process variant's hit count is visible in the recorded test output (not only under --nocapture).
The retry for busy files in reading.rs check_stub is removed; production retry_busy in claude.rs is untouched (git diff shows no non-test production change).

docs/decisions.md and docs/decision-links.toml have an appended entry saying the decision covering crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs was checked and stands; xtask/shard-timings.txt lists any new test file; docs/architecture.md crate table lists athena-testkit.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`, and `cargo test --workspace`: all pass.

out_of_scope: Retries at run sites or in production code
Changing production behavior of claude.rs or other non-test code
Production-code set_permissions uses in crates/athena-core/src/{toolconfig,pin,snapshot}.rs and crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs
departures: Larger than reference: new crate, ~20 files, a syn-based scan, and two prior rejections.
